notes: Derived from flare-engine src/ // @ATTR comments and key-string comparisons.
Type syntax follows docs/gen/attribute-reference.md: list(...) is one-line repetition, repeatable(...) is multi-line.
Map files use a [enemy] section; the engine documents those keys as enemygroup.*.
Map [npc] keys are stored under map.npc; NPC files use npc, dialog and visual_effect.
Map header keys are under map.header (tilewidth/tileheight/orientation are Tiled fields; tilewidth/height are unused by the engine).

classes.description: Description of engine/default_keybindings.txt. Use a bind value of '-1' to clear all bindings for an action. Type may be any of the follwing: 0 = Keyboard, 1 = Mouse, 2 = Gamepad button, 3 = Gamepad Axis. Human-readable key and gamepad mapping names may be used by prefixing the bind with "SDL:" (e.g. "SDL:space" or "SDL:leftstick"). If using the "SDL:" prefix for a gamepad axis, add ":-" to the end of the bind to get the negative direction (e.g. "SDL:leftx:-").

requires_not_status.doc: Statuses required to be unset for enemy group to load

requires_status.doc: Statuses required to be set for enemy group to load

spawn_level.rawType: ["default", "fixed", "source_level", "source_stat", "hero_level", "hero_stat"], float, predefined_string : Mode, Multiplier, Primary stat
spawn_level.doc: The level of spawned creatures. The need for the last two parameters depends on the mode being used. The "default" mode will just use the entity's normal level and doesn't require any additional parameters. The "fixed" mode sets the multiplier as the enemy level. The level modes multiply with the target's level. The stat modes multiply by one of the target's primary stats. The stat is defined with the last parameter, which is simply the ID of the primary stat that should be used for scaling. Because the map has no level/stats of its own, the source modes use the hero's level/stats.

type.doc: (IGNORED BY ENGINE) The "type" field, as used by Tiled and other mapping tools.

wander_radius.doc: The radius (in tiles) that an enemy will wander around randomly; negates waypoints

waypoints.doc: Enemy waypoints; single enemy only; negates wander_radius

absorb_percent.doc: Limits the percentage of damage that can be absorbed. A max value less than 100 will ensure that the target always takes at least 1 damage from non-elemental attacks.

actionbar.doc: A list of powers to place in the action bar for the class.

aim_assist.doc: The pixel offset for powers that use aim_assist.

autopickup_range.doc: Minimum distance the player must be from loot to trigger autopickup.

avoidance_percent.doc: Limits the percentage chance that damage will be avoided.

block_percent.doc: Limits the percentage of damage that can be absorbed when the target is in the 'block' animation state. A max value less than 100 will ensure that the target always takes at least 1 damage from non-elemental attacks.

camera_speed.doc: Modifies how fast the camera moves to recenter on the player. Larger values mean a slower camera. Default value is 10.

campaign.doc: A list of campaign statuses that are set when starting this class.

carried.doc: A list of items that are placed in the normal inventorty when starting with this class.

character_menu.doc: Number of digits after the decimal place to display for values in the 'Character' menu.

combat_aborts_npc_interact.doc: If true, the NPC dialog and vendor menus will be closed if the player is attacked.

combat_text.doc: Number of digits after the decimal place to display for values in combat text.

corpse_timeout.doc: Duration that a corpse can exist on the map in 'ms' or 's'. Use 0 to keep corpses indefinitely.

crit_damage_percent.doc: The percentage of damage dealt when a critical hit occurs.

currency.doc: The amount of currency this class will start with.

currency_id.doc: An item id that will be used as currency.

currency_name.doc: Define the name of currency in game

death_penalty.doc: Number of digits after the decimal place to display for death penalty messages.

default_power_tab.doc: Index of the tab to switch to when opening the Powers menu

drop_max.doc: The maximum number of random item stacks that can drop at once

drop_radius.doc: The distance (in tiles) away from the origin that loot can drop

durations.doc: Number of digits after the decimal place to display for durations.

enable_ally_collision.doc: Allows allies to block the player's path.

enable_ally_collision_ai.doc: Allows allies to block the path of other AI creatures.

enable_playgame.doc: Enables the "Play Game" button on the main menu.

enemy_statbar.doc: Number of digits after the decimal place to display for values in the enemy HP statbar.

equipment.doc: A list of items that are equipped when starting with this class.

equipment_set.rawType: int, list(item_id) : Equipment set ID, Item IDs
equipment_set.doc: A list of items that are equipped to the specified equipment set when starting with this class.

extended_items_offset.doc: Sets the starting item ID that extended items will be stored at. The default value, 0, will place extended items at the directly after the last item ID defined in items/items.txt.

fade_wall_alpha.doc: The minimum opacity which walls will be faded to when covering the player, ranging from 0-255. Use 255 to disable this feature.

fogofwar.doc: Set the fog of war type. 0-disabled, 1-minimap, 2-tint, 3-overlay.

hero_options.doc: A list of indicies of the hero options this class can use.

hide_radius.doc: If an entity is within this radius relative to a piece of loot, the label will be hidden unless highlighted with the cursor.

ignore_texture_filter.doc: If true, this ignores the "Texture Filtering" video setting and uses only nearest-neighbor scaling. This is good for games that use pixel art assets.

interact_range.doc: Distance where the player can interact with objects and NPCs.

item_tooltips.doc: Number of digits after the decimal place to display for values in item tooltips.

keep_buyback_on_map_change.doc: If true, NPC buyback stocks will persist when the map changes. If false, save_buyback is disabled.

level.doc: The amount of XP required for this level.

menu_frame_height.doc: Height of frame for New Game, Configuration, etc. menus.

menu_frame_width.doc: Width of frame for New Game, Configuration, etc. menus.

menus_pause.doc: Opening any menu will pause the game.

min_fps.doc: Sets the minimum frame limit that can be selected in the Video options. It will not change the player's saved max_fps setting if it is lower. If set to 0, this property will be ignored.

miss_damage_percent.doc: The percentage of damage dealt when a miss occurs.

mouse_move_deadzone.rawType: float, float : Deadzone while moving, Deadzone while not moving
mouse_move_deadzone.labels: Deadzone while moving, Deadzone while not moving
mouse_move_deadzone.doc: Adds a deadzone circle around the player to prevent erratic behavior when using mouse movement. Ideally, the deadzone when moving should be less than the deadzone when not moving. Defaults are 0.25 and 0.75 respectively.

mouse_move_enabled.doc: If true, enables the use of the "Move hero using mouse" input option. Defaults to true.

name.doc: The displayed name of this class.

offscreen_enemy_encounters.doc: If true, enemies can enter combat even if they are off-screen. Defaults to false.

orientation.doc: The perspective of tiles; isometric or orthogonal.

overhit_damage_percent.doc: The percentage of damage dealt when an overhit occurs.

party_exp_percentage.doc: The percentage of XP given to allies.

passive_trigger_effect_stacking.doc: For backwards compatibility. Allows adding multiple of the same effect from a power with the same passive trigger. False by default.

permadeath.doc: Force permadeath for all new saves.

player_statbar.doc: Number of digits after the decimal place to display for values in the player's statbars (HP/MP).

poise_style.doc: Controls how the poise stat behaves. The default is "chance", which succeeds if a random roll is less than the target's poise value. The "hp" style succeeds if the ratio of damage taken to the target's maximum HP is less than or equal to the target's poise stat. The "absorb" style succeeds if the ratio of the target's calculated absorption to the damage taken is greater than the target's poise stat.

power_tooltips.doc: Number of digits after the decimal place to display for values in power tooltips (except durations).

power_tree.doc: Power tree that will be loaded by MenuPowers

powers.doc: A list of powers that are unlocked when starting this class.

primary.rawType: predefined_string, int : Primary stat name, Default value
primary.doc: Class starts with this value for the specified stat.

random_item.doc: Removes a random item from the player's inventory.

raycast_resolution.doc: Determines the number of steps used when testing line-of-sight and line-of-movement. A smaller value equates to more accurate results at the cost of performance. Defaults to 0.1.

resist_percent.doc: Limits the percentage of damage that can be resisted. A max value less than 100 will ensure that the target always takes at least 1 damage from elemental attacks.

resource_round_method.doc: Rounds the numbers for most combat events that affect HP/MP. For example: damage taken, HP healed, MP consumed. Defaults to 'round'.

save_anywhere.doc: Enables saving the game with a button in the pause menu.

save_buyback.doc: Saves the vendor buyback stock whenever the game is saved.

save_fogofwar.doc: If true, the fog of war layer keeps track of the progress.

save_hpmp.doc: When saving the game, keep the hero's current HP and MP.

save_oncutscene.doc: Saves the game when triggering any cutscene via an Event.

save_onexit.doc: Save the game upon quitting to the title screen or desktop.

save_onload.doc: Save the game upon changing maps.

save_onstash.doc: Saves the game when changing the contents of a stash. The default is true (i.e. save when using both stash types). Use caution with the values "private" and false, since not saving shared stashes exposes an item duplication exploit.

save_pos_onexit.doc: If the game gets saved on exiting, store the player's current position instead of the map spawn position.

save_prefix.doc: A string that's prepended to save filenames to prevent conflicts between mods.

sell_without_vendor.doc: Allows selling items when not at a vendor via CTRL-Click.

sfx_loot.doc: Filename of a sound effect to play for dropping loot.

sfx_unable_to_cast.doc: Sound to play when the player lacks the MP to cast a power.

sound_falloff.doc: The maximum radius in tiles that any single sound is audible.

tile_size.doc: The width and height of a tile.

tooltip_background_border.doc: The pixel size of the border in "images/menus/tooltips.png".

tooltip_margin.doc: Padding between the text and the tooltip borders.

tooltip_offset.doc: Offset in pixels from the origin point (usually mouse cursor).

tooltip_visible_max.doc: The maximum number of floating tooltips on screen at once. Defaults to 3.

tooltip_width.doc: Maximum width of tooltip in pixels.

vendor_ratio.doc: (Deprecated in v1.12.85; use 'vendor_ratio_sell' instead) Percentage of item buying price to use as selling price. Also used as the buyback price until the player leaves the map.

vendor_ratio_buy.doc: Global multiplier for item prices on the "Buy" tab of vendors. Defaults to 1.0.

vendor_ratio_buyback.doc: (Deprecated in v1.12.85; use 'vendor_ratio_sell_old' instead) Percentage of item buying price to use as the buying price for previously sold items.

vendor_ratio_sell.doc: Global multiplier for the currency gained when selling an item and the price of items on the "Sell" tab of vendors. Defaults to 0.25.

vendor_ratio_sell_old.doc: Global multiplier for item prices on the "Sell" tab of vendors after the player has left the map or quit the game. Falls back to the value of vendor_ratio_sell by default.

virtual_dpi.doc: A target diagonal screen DPI used to determine how much to scale the internal render resolution.

virtual_height.doc: A list of heights (in pixels) that the game can use for its actual rendering area. The virtual height chosen is based on the current window height. The width will be resized to match the window's aspect ratio, and everything will be scaled up to fill the window.

window_title.doc: Sets the text in the window's titlebar.

xp_current_level.doc: Remove this percentage of the XP gained since the last level.

xp_total.doc: Remove this percentage of total XP.

activate.doc: Set the state in which the event will be activated (map events only). on_trigger = the player is standing in the event area or the player interacts with the hotspot. on_interact = the player ineracts with the hotspot. on_mapexit = as the player leaves the map. on_leave = as the player steps outside of an event area they were previously inside of. on_load = as the player enters a map. on_clear = all of the enemies on a map have been defeated. static = constantly, every frame.

book.doc: Opens a book by filename. 'close' can be used in place of the filename to close an already open book.

chance_exec.doc: Percentage chance that this event will execute when triggered.

cooldown.doc: Duration for event cooldown in 'ms' or 's'.

delay.doc: Event will execute after a specified duration.

hotspot.doc: Event uses location as hotspot or defined by rect.

intermap.rawType: filename, int, int, string : Map file, X, Y, Spawn point ID
intermap.doc: Jump to specific map. X/Y (optional) can be used to specifiy the spawn position. Alternatively, use position (-1, -1) and an ID to use the location of an intermap_id event as the spawn point.

intermap_id.doc: Identifier used to specify an alternate spawn point for intermap events.

intermap_random.doc: Pick a random map from a map list file and teleport to it.

intramap.doc: Jump to specific position within current map.

location.doc: Defines the location area for the event.

loot_count.doc: Sets the minimum (and optionally, the maximum) amount of loot this event can drop. Overrides the global drop_max setting.

map.rawType: filename, int, int : Map file, X, Y
map.doc: Adds a map and optional spawn position to the random list of maps to teleport to.

mapmod.rawType: list(predefined_string, int, int, int) : Layer, X, Y, Tile ID

mapmod_toggle.rawType: list(predefined_string, int, int, int, int) : Layer, X, Y, Tile ID A, Tile ID B
mapmod_toggle.doc: Same as mapmod, except this will alternate between two tile IDs.

msg.doc: Adds a message to be displayed for the event.

music.doc: Change background music to specified file.

npc.doc: Filename of an NPC to start dialog with.

parallax_layers.doc: Filename of a parallax layers definition to load.

power_level.rawType: ["default", "fixed", "source_level", "source_stat", "hero_level", "hero_stat"], float, predefined_string : Mode, Multiplier, Primary stat
power_level.doc: Level of this event's power spawner. The need for the last two parameters depends on the mode being used. The "default" mode will just use the entity's normal level and doesn't require any additional parameters. The "fixed" mode sets the multiplier as the enemy level. The level modes multiply with the target's level. The stat modes multiply by one of the target's primary stats. The stat is defined with the last parameter, which is simply the ID of the primary stat that should be used for scaling. Because the map has no level/stats of its own, the source modes use the hero's level/stats.

power_path.rawType: int, int, ["hero", point] : Source X, Source Y, Destination
power_path.doc: Path that an event power will take.

power_stats.doc: Entity stat file to use for this event's power spawner.

procgen_door_level.doc: Event will only be active on a specific door level. For procedural generation chunks only.

procgen_filename.doc: Filename of procedural map generation rules file.

procgen_link.doc: Only used in maps with the procgen_type of "links". Defines a region to be used as a link. The tiles and objects in this region will replace the matching region of the target chunk that has the specified link.

random_status.rawType: repeatable(["append", "clear", "roll", "set", "unset"], list(string)) : Action, Statuses (append action only)
random_status.doc: Used to randomly pick a status from a list, and then set or unset it. Statuses are added to the list with the "append" action. The "roll" action will randomly pick from the list and set it as the current random status. The "set" and "unset" commands will function like set_status and unset_status, with the parameter being the current random status. Lastly, the "clear" action will empty the pool of random statuses. It is recommended to clear the list before you use it, as well as after you're done to prevent unintended side-effects.

reachable_from.doc: If the hero is inside this rectangle, they can activate the event.

remove_currency.doc: Removes specified amount of currency from hero inventory

remove_item.doc: Removes specified item from hero inventory. Quantity can be specified by appending ":Q" to the item_id, where Q is an integer.

repeat.doc: If true, the event to be triggered again.

requires_currency.doc: Event requires atleast this much currency

requires_item.doc: Event requires specific item (not equipped). Quantity can be specified by appending ":Q" to the item_id, where Q is an integer.

requires_not_class.doc: Event requires not this base class

requires_not_currency.doc: Event requires no more than this much currency

requires_not_item.doc: Event requires not having a specific item (not equipped). Quantity can be specified by appending ":Q" to the item_id, where Q is an integer.

requires_not_status.doc: Event requires not list of statuses

requires_not_tile.rawType: list(predefined_string, int, int, int) : Layer, X, Y, Tile ID
requires_not_tile.doc: Event requires tile at this layer and X/Y to not match the ID

requires_tile.rawType: list(predefined_string, int, int, int) : Layer, X, Y, Tile ID
requires_tile.doc: Event requires tile at this layer and X/Y to match the ID

respec.rawType: ["xp", "stats", "powers"], bool : Respec mode, Ignore class defaults
respec.doc: Resets various aspects of the character's progression. Resetting "xp" also resets "stats". Resetting "stats" also resets "powers".

restore.doc: Restore the hero's HP, MP, and/or status. Resource stat base IDs are also valid.

reward_currency.doc: Reward hero with specified amount of currency.

reward_item.doc: Reward hero with a specified item. Quantity can be specified by appending ":Q" to the item_id, where Q is an integer. To maintain backwards compatibility, the quantity must be defined for at least the first item in the list in order to use this syntax.

reward_loot_count.doc: Sets the minimum (and optionally, the maximum) amount of loot that reward_loot can give the hero. Defaults to 1.

reward_xp.doc: Reward hero with specified amount of experience points.

save_game.doc: If true, the game is saved when the event is triggered. The respawn position is set to where the player is standing.

script.doc: Loads and executes an Event from a file.

shakycam.doc: Makes the camera shake for this duration in 'ms' or 's'.

show_on_minimap.doc: If true, this event will be shown on the minimap if it is the appropriate type (e.g. an intermap teleport).

soundfx.rawType: filename, int, int, bool : Sound file, X, Y, loop
soundfx.doc: Filename of a sound to play. Optionally, it can be played at a specific location and/or looped. Note: Sounds attached to 'on_load' events will loop by default.

spawn.rawType: list(predefined_string, int, int) : Enemy category, X, Y
spawn.doc: Spawn an enemy from this category at location

spawn_level.rawType: ["default", "fixed", "source_level", "source_stat", "hero_level", "hero_stat"], float, predefined_string : Mode, Multiplier, Primary stat
spawn_level.doc: Level of the spawned entities. The need for the last two parameters depends on the mode being used. The "default" mode will just use the entity's normal level and doesn't require any additional parameters. The "fixed" mode sets the multiplier as the entity level. The level modes multiply with the target's level. The stat modes multiply by one of the target's primary stats. The stat is defined with the last parameter, which is simply the ID of the primary stat that should be used for scaling. Because the map has no level/stats of its own, the source modes use the hero's level/stats.

stash.doc: If true, the Stash menu if opened.

type.doc: (IGNORED BY ENGINE) The "type" field, as used by Tiled and other mapping tools.

id.doc: An identifier for this equip flag.

name.doc: The displayed name of this equip flag.

id.doc: An identifier used to reference this font.

style.rawType: repeatable(["default", predefined_string], filename, int, bool, bool, bool, bool, int, int) : Language, Font file, Point size, Blending, Bold, Italic, Underline, Shadow offset X, Shadow offset Y
style.labels: Language, Font file, Point size, Blending, Bold, Italic, Underline, Shadow offset X, Shadow offset Y
style.doc: Filename, point size, blend mode, style (optional), and shadow offset (optional) of the font to use for this language. Language can be "default" or a 2-letter region code.

bit.doc: A fog of war bit definition can have any name. Better to keep it simple and short. There must be a bit definition that has the value 0. Example: If we have 4 bits per tile then we define: bit=BIT_0,0, bit=BIT_N,1, bit=BIT_W,2, bit=BIT_S,3, bit=BIT_E,4.

bits_per_tile.doc: How may bits(subdivisions) a tile is made of. In powers of two. Example: if it is set to 4 then the tile will be subdivided in 4, let's say North, South, East, West.

color_dark.doc: Tint color for dark tiles. Used by fog of war type 2-tint.

color_fog.doc: Tint color for fog tiles. Used by fog of war type 2-tint.

radius.doc: Fog of war mask radius, also how far the player can see.

tileset_dark.doc: Filename of a tileset definition to use for unvisited areas. Used by fog of war type 3-overlay.

tileset_fog.doc: Filename of a tileset definition to use for foggy areas. Used by fog of war type 3-overlay.

data.doc: The mask definition is a matrix (2\*radius+1 by 2\*radius+1) that contains fog of war tile definitions. All the margins of the matrix must be the tile definition that contains all bits.

tile.doc: A fog of war tile definition can have any name. Better to keep it simple and short. There must be a tile definition that contains no bits and a tile definition that contains all bits. Example: A tile containing North and West bits will be tile=NW,BIT_N,BIT_W.

text_width.doc: The pixel width of the text area that displays the currently selected item. Default is 150 pixels;

image_icon.doc: Use an icon as the image instead of a file.

requires_not_status.doc: Image must not have any of these campaign statuses in order to be visible.

requires_status.doc: Image requires these campaign statuses in order to be visible.

abs.doc: Defines the item absorb value, if only min is specified the absorb value is fixed.

abs_max.doc: Same as the 'max' component of the 'abs' property, but supports level-scaled syntax.

abs_min.doc: Same as the 'min' component of the 'abs' property, but supports level-scaled syntax.

bonus.doc: Adds a bonus to the item by stat ID, example: bonus=hp,50

bonus_power_level.rawType: repeatable(power_id, list(level_scaled_value)) : Base power, Bonus levels
bonus_power_level.doc: Grants bonus levels to a given base power.

book.doc: A book file to open when this item is activated.

book_is_readable.doc: If true, "read" is displayed in the tooltip instead of "use". Defaults to true.

crafting_items.doc: A list of items that are required to craft this item from within the vendor menu. Quantity can be specified by appending ":Q" to the item_id, where Q is an integer.

disable_slots.doc: A comma separated list of equip slot types to disable when this item is equipped.

dmg.rawType: predefined_string, float, float : Damage type, Min, Max
dmg.doc: Defines the item's base damage type and range. Max may be ommitted and will default to Min.

dmg_max.doc: Same as the 'max' component of the 'dmg' property, but supports level-scaled syntax.

dmg_min.doc: Same as the 'min' component of the 'dmg' property, but supports level-scaled syntax.

equip_flags.doc: A comma separated list of flags to set when this item is equipped. See engine/equip_flags.txt.

gfx.doc: Filename of an animation set to display when the item is equipped.

icon.doc: An id for the icon to display for this item.

id.doc: An uniq id of the item used as reference from other classes.

item_type.doc: Equipment slot matching an id in items/types.txt

loot_animation.rawType: repeatable(filename, int, int) : Loot image, Min quantity, Max quantity
loot_animation.doc: Specifies the loot animation file for the item. The max quantity, or both quantity values, may be omitted.

loot_drops_max.doc: The number of instances of this item that can drop during a single loot event.

name.doc: Item name displayed on long and short tooltips.

no_stash.doc: If not set to 'ignore', this item will not be able to be put in the corresponding stash.

pickup_status.doc: Set campaign statuses when item is picked up. Typically used for quest items.

power.doc: Adds a specific power to the item which makes it usable as a power and can be placed in action bar.

power_desc.doc: A string describing the additional power.

price.doc: The amount of currency the item costs, if set to 0 the item cannot be sold.

price_per_level.doc: (Deprecated in v1.14.17; Use 'price=player_level:{value}' instead). Additional price for each player level above 1

price_sell.doc: The amount of currency the item is sold for, if set to 0 the sell prices is prices*vendor_ratio.

quality.doc: Item quality matching an id in items/qualities.txt

quest_item.doc: If true, this item is a quest item and can not be dropped or sold. The item also can't be stashed, unless the no_stash property is set to something other than "all".

randomizer_def.doc: Randomizer definition file for this item. See "ItemManager: Randomizer Definition".

replace_power.rawType: repeatable(power_id, power_id) : Old power, New power
replace_power.doc: Replaces the old power id with the new power id in the action bar when equipped.

requires_class.doc: The hero's base class (engine/classes.txt) must match for this item to be equipped.

requires_level.doc: The hero's level must match or exceed this value in order to equip this item.

requires_stat.rawType: repeatable(predefined_string, list(level_scaled_value)) : Primary stat name, Value
requires_stat.doc: Make item require specific stat level ex. requires_stat=physical,6 will require hero to have level 6 in physical stats

script.doc: Loads and executes a script file when the item is activated from the player's inventory.

soundfx.doc: Sound effect filename to play for the specific item.

soundfx_craft.doc: Sound effect filename to play when crafting this item in the Vendor menu's Craft tab.

soundfx_craft_override.doc: If false (the default), this item's soundfx_craft will play in unison with the Vendor's soundfx_craft. Otherwise, only this item's soundfx_craft will play.

stepfx.doc: Sound effect when walking, this applies only to armors.

sort_order.doc: Defines the order to be used when sorting items by type.

format.doc: Format for map layer, must be 'dec'

text_margin.rawType: int, int : Left margin, Right margin
text_margin.doc: The pixel margin to leave on the left and right sides of listbox element text.

padding.doc: The padding in pixels of the log text area.

chance.doc: The chance that the item will drop. "fixed" will drop the item no matter what before the random items are picked. This is different than setting a chance of 100, in which the item could be replaced with another random item.

id.doc: The ID of the loot item. "currency" will use the item ID defined as currency_id in engine/misc.txt.

loot.doc: Compact form of defining a loot table entry.

quantity.rawType: int, int : Min quantity, Max quantity (optional)
quantity.doc: The quantity of item in the dropped loot stack.

quantity_per_level.rawType: int, int: Min quantity, Max quantity
quantity_per_level.doc: Multiplied by the player level minus one and added on top of 'quantity'.

requires_level.rawType: int, int : Min player level, Max player level
requires_level.labels: Min player level, Max player level
requires_level.doc: The player's level must be in this range for the item to drop.

requires_status.doc: A single campaign status that is required for the item to be able to drop. Status IDs only; status expressions are not supported here.

status_loot.rawType: string, loot : Required status, Loot definition
status_loot.doc: Compact form of defining a loot table entry with a required campaign status.

fogofwar.doc: Set the fog of war type. 0-disabled, 1-minimap, 2-tint, 3-overlay. Overrides engine settings.

hero_pos.doc: The player will spawn in this location if no point was previously given.

music.doc: Filename of background music to use for map

parallax_layers.doc: Filename of a parallax layers definition.

procgen_reset_status.doc: If the map contains a procgen region, it will be regenerated if this campaign status is set.

procgen_type.doc: Defines the type of chunk this map is when used in procedural map generation.

procgen_unique_status.doc: Sets this campaign status once this map is placed as a chunk during procedural generation. Once the status is set, the chunk will no longer be eligible to be placed.

save_fogofwar.doc: If true, the fog of war layer keeps track of the progress. Overrides engine settings.

tileheight.doc: Inherited from Tiled map file. Unused by engine.

tileset.doc: Filename of a tileset definition to use for map

tilewidth.doc: Inherited from Tiled map file. Unused by engine.

direction.doc: Direction that NPC will initially face.

requires_class.doc: Player base class required to load NPC

requires_currency.doc: Player currency must be equal or greater to load NPC

requires_item.doc: Item required to exist in player inventory to load NPC. Quantity can be specified by appending ":Q" to the item_id, where Q is an integer.

requires_level.doc: Player level must be equal or greater to load NPC

requires_not_class.doc: Player base class not required to load NPC

requires_not_currency.doc: Player currency must be lesser to load NPC

requires_not_item.doc: Item required to not exist in player inventory to load NPC. Quantity can be specified by appending ":Q" to the item_id, where Q is an integer.

requires_not_level.doc: Player level must be lesser to load NPC

requires_not_status.doc: Statuses required to be unset for NPC load

requires_status.doc: Statuses required to be set for NPC load

type.doc: (IGNORED BY ENGINE) The "type" field, as used by Tiled and other mapping tools.

wander_radius.doc: The radius (in tiles) that an NPC will wander around randomly; negates waypoints

colorblind_highlight_offset.rawType: int, int : X offset, Y offset
colorblind_highlight_offset.doc: The pixel offset of the '*' marker on highlighted icons in colorblind mode.

selection_rect_color.doc: Color of the selection rectangle when navigating widgets without a mouse.

selection_rect_corner_size.doc: Size of the corners on the selection rectangle shown when navigating widgets. Set to 0 to drawn the entire rectangle instead.

description_locale.doc: A translated description for a language (specified by 2-letter code).

engine_version_max.doc: The maximum engine version required to use this mod.

engine_version_min.doc: The minimum engine version required to use this mod.

game.doc: The game which this mod belongs to (e.g. flare-game).

requires.doc: A comma-separated list of the mods that are required in order to use this mod. The dependency version requirements can also be specified and separated by colons (e.g. fantasycore:0.1:2.0).

version.doc: The version number of this mod.

constant_stock.doc: A list of items this vendor has for sale. Quantity can be specified by appending ":Q" to the item_id, where Q is an integer.

craft_constant_stock.doc: A list of items this vendor can craft.

craft_random_stock.doc: Use a loot table to add random items to the Craft stock; either a filename or an inline definition.

craft_random_stock_count.doc: Sets the minimum (and optionally, the maximum) amount of random items this npc can have in their Craft stock.

craft_status_stock.doc: A list of items this vendor can craft if the required status is met.

direction.doc: The direction to use for this NPC's stance animation.

portrait.doc: Filename of the default portrait image.

random_stock.doc: Use a loot table to add random items to the stock; either a filename or an inline definition.

random_stock_count.doc: Sets the minimum (and optionally, the maximum) amount of random items this npc can have.

show_on_minimap.doc: If true, this NPC will be shown on the minimap. The default is true.

status_stock.doc: A list of items this vendor will have for sale if the required status is met. Quantity can be specified by appending ":Q" to the item_id, where Q is an integer.

talker.doc: Allows this NPC to be talked to.

vendor.doc: Allows this NPC to buy/sell items.

vendor_gamble_buy.doc: If true (the default is false), the damage, absorb and bonuses for randomized items on the Buy tab will be hidden until purchase.

vendor_gamble_craft.doc: If true (the default is false), the damage, absorb and bonuses for randomized items on the Craft tab will be hidden until purchase.

vendor_ratio_buy.doc: NPC-specific version of vendor_ratio_buy from engine/loot.txt. Uses the global setting when set to 0.

vendor_ratio_sell.doc: NPC-specific version of vendor_ratio_sell from engine/loot.txt. Uses the global setting when set to 0.

vendor_ratio_sell_old.doc: NPC-specific version of vendor_ratio_sell_old from engine/loot.txt. Uses the global setting when set to 0.

vendor_requires_not_status.doc: The player must not have these statuses in order to use this NPC as a vendor.

vendor_requires_status.doc: The player must have these statuses in order to use this NPC as a vendor.

vendor_tab_enabled.doc: Sets the enabled state of the specified vendor tab for this NPC. The "buy" and "sell" tabs are enabled by default.

vox_intro.doc: Filename of a sound file to play when initially interacting with the NPC.

bonus_count.rawType: int, int : Minimum count, Maximum count
bonus_count.doc: The range used to determine the number of bonuses for the item.

chance.doc: Percent chance that this option will be picked when generating an item.

level_range.rawType: int, int : Minimum level, Maximum level
level_range.doc: The range used to determine the item level. The resulting item level is relative, depending on the value of option.level_src.

level_src.doc: Determines how option.level_range will be applied. If "base", the source item's level will be used. If "hero", the player's current level will be used.

quality.doc: The quality ID that will be assigned to the item.

fixed_speed.rawType: float, float : X speed, Y speed
fixed_speed.doc: Speed at which the background will move independent of the camera movement.

image.doc: Image file to use as a scrolling background.

map_layer.doc: The tile map layer that this parallax layer will be rendered on top of.

speed.doc: Speed at which the background will move relative to the camera.

aim_assist.doc: If true, power targeting will be offset vertically by the number of pixels set with "aim_assist" in engine/misc.txt.

angle_variance.doc: Percentage of variance added to missile angle

animation.doc: The filename of the power animation.

attack_speed.doc: Changes attack animation speed for this Power. A value of 100 is 100% speed (aka normal speed).

base_damage.doc: Determines which damage stat will be used to calculate damage.

beacon.doc: True if enemy is calling its allies.

buff.doc: Power is cast upon the caster.

buff_party.doc: Power is cast upon party members

buff_party_power_id.doc: Only party members that were spawned with this power ID are affected by "buff_party=true". Setting this to 0 will affect all party members.

can_trigger_passives.doc: If true, this power can trigger passive powers that have passive_trigger=on_active_power.

charge_duration.doc: Defines how long the charge_speed is applied. If set to 0, this property is ignored and the state animation is used to set the duration.

charge_speed.doc: Moves the caster at this speed in the direction they are facing for the duration specified by charge_duration or until the state animation is finished (whichever is shorter).

complete_animation.doc: For hazards; Play the entire animation, even if the hazard has hit a target.

cooldown.doc: Specify the duration for cooldown of the power in 'ms' or 's'.

count.doc: The count of hazards/effect or spawns to be created by this power.

directional.doc: The animation sprite sheet contains 8 directions, one per row.

disable_equip_slots.doc: Passive powers only. A comma separated list of equip slot types to disable when this power is active.

dispel.doc: Removes any colliding hazards that match the specified Power IDs. Works best with multitarget=true.

expire_power.rawType: repeatable(power_id, int) : Power, Chance to cast
expire_power.doc: Trigger a power when the hazard's lifespan expires.

expire_with_caster.doc: If true, hazard will disappear when the caster dies.

face.doc: Power will make hero or enemy to face the target location.

floor.doc: The hazard is drawn between the background and the object layer.

hp_steal.doc: Percentage of damage to steal into HP

icon.doc: The icon to visually represent the power eg. in skill tree or action bar.

id.doc: A power id from powers/powers.txt for this slot.

ignore_zero_damage.doc: If true, hazard can still hit the player when damage is 0, triggering post_power and post_effects.

lifespan.doc: How long the hazard/animation lasts in 'ms' or 's'.

lock_target_to_direction.doc: If true, the target is "snapped" to one of the 8 directions.

meta_power.doc: If true, this power can not be used on it's own. Instead, it should be replaced via an item with a replace_power entry.

meta_power_provides_tooltip.doc: If this power is a meta power and is replaced, this flag being true will cause the actionbar to use this meta power for its tooltip. Defaults to true.

modifier_critical.doc: Changes the chance that this power will land a critical hit.

modifier_damage.doc: Changes this power's damage. The "Max" value is ignored, except in the case of "absolute" modifiers.

movement_type.doc: For moving hazards (missile/repeater), this defines which parts of the map it can collide with. The default is "flying".

mp_steal.doc: Percentage of damage to steal into MP

multihit.doc: Allows a hazard power to hit the same entity more than once.

multitarget.doc: Allows a hazard power to hit more than one entity.

new_state.doc: When power is used, hero or enemy will change to this state. Must be one of the states ["instant", user defined]

no_actionbar.doc: If true, this power is prevented from being placed on the actionbar.

no_aggro.doc: If true, the Hazard won't put its target in a combat state.

passive.doc: If power is unlocked when the hero or enemy spawns it will be automatically activated.

passive_effects_persist.doc: If true, post effects from this passive power will not be removed if the passive power is deactivated.

passive_trigger.doc: This will only activate a passive power under a certain condition.

position.doc: Position of this power icon; relative to MenuPowers "pos".

post_effect.rawType: predefined_string, float, duration , float: Effect ID, Magnitude, Duration, Chance to apply
post_effect.doc: Post effect to apply to target. Duration is in 'ms' or 's'.

post_effect_src.rawType: predefined_string, float, duration , float: Effect ID, Magnitude, Duration, Chance to apply
post_effect_src.doc: Post effect to apply to caster. Duration is in 'ms' or 's'.

post_hazards_skip_target.doc: When this power's hazard hits a target, this property determines if hazards spawned by post_power can hit the same target.

post_power.rawType: repeatable(power_id, int) : Power, Chance to cast
post_power.doc: Trigger a power if the hazard did damage. For 'block' type powers, this power will be triggered when the blocker takes damage.

pre_power.rawType: repeatable(power_id, float) : Power, Chance to cast
pre_power.doc: Trigger a power immediately when casting this one.

prevent_interrupt.doc: Prevents the caster from being interrupted by a hit when casting this power.

relative_pos.doc: Hazard will move relative to the caster's position.

remove_effect.rawType: repeatable(predefined_string, int) : Effect ID, Number of Effect instances
remove_effect.doc: Removes a number of instances of a specific Effect ID. Omitting the number of instances, or setting it to zero, will remove all instances/stacks.

replace_by_effect.rawType: repeatable(power_id, predefined_string, int) : Power ID, Effect ID, Number of Effect instances
replace_by_effect.doc: If the caster has at least the number of instances of the Effect ID, the defined Power ID will be cast instead.

requires_corpse.doc: If true, a corpse must be targeted for this power to be used. If "consume", then the corpse is also consumed on Power use.

requires_empty_target.doc: The power can only be cast when target tile is empty.

requires_equipped_item.doc: Requires a specific item of a specific quantity to be equipped on hero. If quantity > 0, then the item will be removed.

requires_flags.doc: A comma separated list of equip flags that are required to use this power. See engine/equip_flags.txt

requires_hp.doc: Require an amount of HP to use the power. The amount will be consumed on usage.

requires_hpmp_state.rawType: ["all", "any"], ["percent", "not_percent", "percent_exact", "ignore"], float , ["percent", "not_percent", "percent_exact", "ignore"], float: Mode, HP state, HP Percentage value, MP state, MP Percentage value
requires_hpmp_state.doc: Power can only be used when HP/MP matches the specified state. In 'all' mode, both HP and MP must meet the requirements, where as only one must in 'any' mode. To check a single stat, use 'all' mode and set the 'ignore' state for the other stat.

requires_item.doc: Requires a specific item of a specific quantity in inventory. If quantity > 0, then the item will be removed.

requires_level.doc: Power requires at least this level for the hero.

requires_mp.doc: Require an amount of MP to use the power. The amount will be consumed on usage.

requires_not_status.doc: Power requires not having this campaign status.

requires_point.doc: Power requires a power point to unlock.

requires_primary.rawType: predefined_string, int : Primary stat name, Required value
requires_primary.doc: Power requires this primary stat to be at least the specificed value.

requires_resource_stat.rawType: repeatable(predefined_string, float) : Resource stat ID, Required amount
requires_resource_stat.doc: Requires an amount of a given resource to use the power. The amount will be consumed on usage.

requires_resource_stat_state.rawType: predefined_string, ["percent", "not_percent", "percent_exact", "ignore"], float : Resource stat ID, State, Percentage value
requires_resource_stat_state.doc: Power can only be used when the resource stat matches the specified state. See 'requires_resource_stat_state_mode' for combining multiple resource states and, optionally, HP/MP state.

requires_spawns.doc: The caster must have at least this many summoned creatures to use this power.

requires_targeting.doc: Power is only used when targeting using click-to-target.

resource_steal.rawType: repeatable(predefined_string, float) : Resource stat ID, Steal amount
resource_steal.doc: Percentage of damage to steal into the specified resource

sacrifice.doc: If the power has requires_hp, allow it to kill the caster.

script.doc: Loads and executes a script file when the trigger is activated.

soundfx.doc: Filename of a sound effect to play when the power is used.

soundfx_hit.doc: Filename of a sound effect to play when the power's hazard hits a valid target.

source_type.doc: Determines which entities the power can effect.

spawn_level.rawType: ["default", "fixed", "source_level", "source_stat", "hero_level", "hero_stat"], float, predefined_string : Mode, Multiplier, Primary stat
spawn_level.doc: The level of spawned creatures. The need for the last two parameters depends on the mode being used. The "default" mode will just use the entity's normal level and doesn't require any additional parameters. The "fixed" mode sets the multiplier as the enemy level. The level modes multiply with the target's level. The stat modes multiply by one of the target's primary stats. The stat is defined with the last parameter, which is simply the ID of the primary stat that should be used for scaling.

spawn_limit.rawType: ["unlimited", "fixed", "stat"], int, float, predefined_string : Mode, Entity Level, Ratio, Primary stat
spawn_limit.doc: The maximum number of creatures that can be spawned and alive from this power. The need for the last three parameters depends on the mode being used. The "unlimited" mode requires no parameters and will remove any spawn limit requirements. The "fixed" mode takes one parameter as the spawn limit. The "stat" mode also requires the ratio and primary stat ID as parameters. The ratio adjusts the scaling of the spawn limit. For example, spawn_limit=stat,1,2,physical will set the spawn limit to 1/2 the summoner's Physical stat.

spawn_requires_unlocked_power.doc: Defaults to true. When set to false, spawns won't be killed when the spawning power is locked.

spawn_type.doc: For non-transform powers, an enemy is spawned from this category. For transform powers, the caster will transform into a creature from this category.

speed.doc: The speed of missile hazard, the unit is defined as map units per frame.

speed_variance.doc: Percentage of variance added to missile speed

state_duration.doc: Sets the length of time the caster is in their state animation. A time longer than the animation length will cause the animation to pause on the frame specified by state_hold_mode (active frame if not specified). Times shorter than the state animation length will have no effect.

state_hold_mode.doc: Determines which frame will be held when using state_duration.

tab.doc: Tab index to place this power on, starting from 0.

target_categories.doc: Hazard will only affect enemies in these categories.

target_movement_normal.doc: Power can affect entities with normal movement (aka walking on ground)

target_nearest.doc: Will automatically target the nearest enemy within the specified range.

target_neighbor.doc: Target is changed to an adjacent tile within a radius.

target_party.doc: Hazard will only affect party members.

target_range.doc: The distance from the caster that the power can be activated

trait_crits_impaired.doc: Increases critical hit percentage for slowed/immobile targets

trait_elemental.doc: Converts all damage done to a given damage type (see engine/damage_types.txt). Despite the name, this is not restricted to "elemental" damage types.

type.doc: Defines the type of power definiton

untransform_on_hit.doc: Force untransform when the player is hit

upgrades.doc: A list of upgrade power ids that this power slot can upgrade to. Each of these powers should have a matching upgrade section.

visible.doc: Controls whether or not a power is visible or hidden regardless of unlocked state. Defaults to true.

visible_check_locked.doc: When set to true, the power will be hidden if it is locked. Defaults to false.

visible_check_status.doc: When set to true, the power will be hidden if its status requirements are not met. Defaults to false.

visible_requires_not_status.doc: (Deprecated as of v1.11.75) Hide the power if we have this campaign status.

visible_requires_status.doc: (Deprecated as of v1.11.75) Hide the power if we don't have this campaign status.

visual_option.doc: If the power is not directional, this option determines which direction should be used for the animation.

visual_random.doc: If the power is not directional, this option determines which direction should be used for the animation. The resulting direction is random in the range of (visual_option, visual_option + visual_random).

wall_power.rawType: repeatable(power_id, int) : Power, Chance to cast
wall_power.doc: Trigger a power if the hazard hit a wall.

wall_reflect.doc: Moving power will bounce off walls and keep going

walls_block_aoe.doc: When true, prevents hazard aoe from hitting targets that are behind walls/pits.

overlay_icon.doc: The icon to be used as an overlay.

complete_status.doc: If this status is set, the quest will be displayed as completed.

name.doc: A displayed name for this quest.

quest_text.doc: Text that gets displayed in the Quest log when this quest is active.

requires_currency.doc: Quest requires atleast this much currency

requires_not_class.doc: Quest requires not this base class

requires_not_currency.doc: Quest requires no more than this much currency

requires_not_item.doc: Quest requires not having a specific item (not equipped)

requires_not_status.doc: Quest requires not having this campaign status.

show_status.doc: Displays the value of the given status ID after the quest text.

level.doc: The multiplier that will be applied to the rewarded XP when an enemy's level is X levels apart from the player's level. If the enemy's level is outside the defined scaling levels, the min or max level is used (whichever is closer).

layer.doc: Defines the layer order of slots for a given direction.

levelup_restore.doc: If true, this resource stat will be restored on level up. Defaults to true.

menu_filename.doc: The MenuStatBar definition file to use for displaying this stat.

stat_base.doc: The identifier used for the base ("Max") stat.

stat_heal.doc: The identifier used for heal-over-time effects.

stat_heal_percent.doc: The identifier used for percentage-based heal-over-time effects.

stat_regen.doc: The identifier used for the regeneration stat.

stat_resist_steal.doc: The identifier used for the resistance to steal stat.

stat_steal.doc: The identifier used for steal stat.

text_base.doc: The printed name of the base ("Max") stat as seen in-game.

text_base_desc.doc: The printed description of the base ("Max") stat as seen in-game.

text_combat_heal.doc: The name of the stat in combat text as seen during heal-over-time.

text_log_low.doc: The text in the player's log when trying to use a Power that requires more than the available amount of this resource.

text_log_restore.doc: The text in the player's log when this stat is restored via EventManager's 'restore' property.

text_regen.doc: The name of the regeneration stat as seen in-game.

text_regen_desc.doc: The description of the regeneration stat as seen in-game.

text_resist_steal.doc: The name of the resistance to steal stat as seen in-game.

text_resist_steal_desc.doc: The description of the resistance to steal stat as seen in-game.

text_steal.doc: The name of the steal stat as seen in-game.

text_steal_desc.doc: The description of the steal stat as seen in-game.

text_tooltip_cost.doc: The text in Power tooltips that describes the casting cost of this resource.

text_tooltip_heal.doc: The text in Power tooltips used for heal-over-time Effects.

caption.doc: A caption that will be shown.

image.doc: Filename of an image that will be shown. The scaling type is a value between 0-2, corresponding to: none, fit height, fit screen.

pause.doc: Pause before next component in 'ms' or 's'. A value of '-1' may be used to pause indefinitely.

soundfx.doc: Filename of a sound that will be played

bg_color.doc: The background color for the entire scrollbar.

bonus.rawType: repeatable(int, stat_id, list(level_scaled_value)) : Required set item count, Stat ID, Value
bonus.doc: Bonus to append to items in the set.

bonus_power_level.rawType: repeatable(int, power_id, list(level_scaled_value)) : Required set item count, Base power, Bonus levels
bonus_power_level.doc: Grants bonus levels to a given base power.

color.doc: A specific of color for the set.

id.doc: A uniq id for the item set.

items.doc: List of item id's that is part of the set.

branch_length_max.doc: Maximum number of steps taken when creating a branch off the main path.

branch_length_min.doc: Minimum number of steps taken when creating a branch off the main path.

branches_per_door_level_max.doc: Maximum number of branches that can be created between each 'door level'. A door level is defined as the set of chunks between a set of 2 door chunks (start and end chunks count as doors here).

door_spacing_min.doc: The minimum number of chunk length of each door level.

doors_max.doc: Maximum number of door chunks that can be placed in this region.

main_path_attempts_max.doc: Maximum number of attempts to generate the main path to match the min/max constraints.

main_path_length_max.doc: Maximum length of the 'main' path (start chunk to end chunk).

main_path_length_min.doc: Minimum length of the 'main' path (start chunk to end chunk).

hotkey_bg_color.doc: If a slot has a hotkey, a rectangle filled with this color will be placed beneath the text.

hotkey_color.doc: Text color for the slot hotkey text.

hotkey_label.doc: Setting for the slot hotkey text.

quantity_bg_color.doc: If a slot has a quantity, a rectangle filled with this color will be placed beneath the text.

quantity_color.doc: Text color for the slot quantity text.

quantity_label.doc: Setting for the slot quantity text.

activate.doc: The sound effect file to play when certain widgets are activated/clicked.

id.doc: An identifier for this primary stat.

name.doc: The displayed name of this primary stat.

categories.doc: Categories that this entity belongs to.

chance_flee.doc: Percentage chance that the creature will run away from their target.

chance_pursue.doc: Percentage change that the creature will chase their target.

combat_style.doc: How the creature will enter combat. Default is within range of the hero; Aggressive is always in combat; Passive must be attacked to enter combat. If the entity should never enter combat, set this to "disabled".

convert_status.doc: Campaign status to set upon being converted to a player ally.

cooldown_hit.doc: Duration of cooldown after being hit in 'ms' or 's'.

cooldown_los.doc: If line-of-sight is broken for this amount of time, the entity will exit the combat state.

corpse_has_collision.doc: If true, the entity will have collision after it dies. Defaults to false.

corpse_has_timeout.doc: If true, the entity's corpse will fade out after the corpse_timeout elapses (see EngineSettings: Misc). Defaults to true.

corpse_render_below.doc: If true, the entity's corpse will be rendered on the bottom-most layer. Defaults to true.

defeat_status.doc: Campaign status to set upon death.

facing.doc: Creature can turn to face their target.

first_defeat_loot.doc: Drops this item upon first death (requires defeat_status to be set).

flee_cooldown.doc: The amount of time this creature must wait before they can start fleeing again.

flee_duration.doc: The minimum amount of time that this creature will flee. They may flee longer than the specified time.

flee_range.doc: The radius at which this creature will start moving to a safe distance. Defaults to half of the threat_range.

humanoid.doc: This creature gives human traits when transformed into, such as the ability to talk with NPCs.

levelup_restore_hp.doc: If true, HP will be restored on level up. Defaults to true.

levelup_restore_mp.doc: If true, MP will be restored on level up. Defaults to true.

lifeform.doc: Determines whether or not this entity is referred to as a living thing, such as displaying "Dead" vs "Destroyed" when their HP is 0.

loot.doc: Possible loot that can be dropped on death.

loot_count.doc: Sets the minimum (and optionally, the maximum) amount of loot this creature can drop. Overrides the global drop_max setting.

max_points_per_stat.doc: Maximum points for each primary stat.

melee_range.doc: Determines the distance from the caster that some powers will be placed. For AI entities, it also means the minimum distance from target required to use melee powers.

passive_powers.doc: A list of passive powers this creature has.

power.doc: A power that has a chance of being triggered in a certain state.

power_filter.doc: Only these powers are allowed to hit this entity.

power_points_per_level.doc: The amount of power points awarded each level.

quest_loot.rawType: status, status, item_id : Required status, Required not status, Item
quest_loot.labels: Required status, Required not status, Item
quest_loot.doc: Drops this item when campaign status is met. Can't drop at the same time as first_defeat_loot.

resting_hp_regen_time.doc: When not in combat, this is how much time it will take to regenerate HP from zero to max. Default is 5 seconds. Set to 0 to disable resting HP regen.

sfx_attack.rawType: repeatable(predefined_string, filename) : Animation name, Sound file
sfx_attack.doc: Filename of sound effect for the specified attack animation.

sfx_block.doc: Filename of sound effect for blocking an incoming hit.

sfx_critdie.doc: Filename of sound effect for dying to a critical hit.

sfx_die.doc: Filename of sound effect for dying.

sfx_hit.doc: Filename of sound effect for being hit.

sfx_levelup.doc: Filename of sound effect for leveling up.

sfx_lowhp.doc: Filename of sound effect for low health warning. Optionally, it can be looped.

sfx_step.doc: An id for a set of step sound effects. See items/step_sounds.txt.

stat.doc: The starting value for this stat.

stat_per_level.doc: The value for this stat added per level.

stat_per_primary.rawType: predefined_string, stat_id, float : Primary Stat, Stat ID, Value
stat_per_primary.doc: The value for this stat added for every point allocated to this primary stat.

stat_points_per_level.doc: The amount of stat points awarded each level.

suppress_hp.doc: Hides the enemy HP bar for this creature.

threat_range.rawType: float, float: Engage distance, Stop distance
threat_range.doc: The first value is the radius of the area this creature will be able to start chasing the hero. The second, optional, value is the radius at which this creature will stop pursuing their target and defaults to double the first value.

turn_delay.doc: Duration it takes for this creature to turn and face their target in 'ms' or 's'.

vulnerable.doc: (Deprecated in v1.12.91; use a '..._resist' value with 'stat' instead) Percentage weakness to this element.

waypoint_pause.doc: Duration to wait at each waypoint in 'ms' or 's'.

background_color.doc: Color and alpha of the subtitle background rectangle.

pos.doc: Position of the subtitle text relative to alignment.

text_pos.doc: Position and style of the subtitle text.

id.doc: Filename of the sound file that will trigger this subtitle.

text.doc: The subtitle text that will be displayed.

background.doc: Filename of the background image for this tab's power tree

is_private.doc: If true, this stash will not be shared across other saves.

name.doc: The displayed name of this tab. It is also used to determine the filename of the stash file that the engine will create. 'Private' and 'Shared' will use their legacy filenames for compatibility.

padding.rawType: int, int : Left/right padding, Top padding
padding.doc: The pixel padding around tabs. Controls how the left and right edges are drawn.

text_padding.doc: The padding (in pixels) on the left and right sides of the tab's text label. In contrast to 'padding', this does not affect how the tab background is drawn.

title.doc: The name of this power tree tab

requires_not_status.doc: Text must not have any of these campaign statuses in order to be visible.

requires_status.doc: Text requires these campaign statuses in order to be visible.

text_font.rawType: color, string : Font color, Font style

text_pos.rawType: int, int, int, ["left", "center", "right"] : X, Y, Width, Text justify

text_shadow.doc: If true, the text will have a black shadow like the text labels in various menus.

animation.rawType: list(int, int, int, duration) : Tile index, X, Y, duration
animation.doc: An animation for a tile. Durations are in 'ms' or 's'.

img.doc: Filename of a tile sheet image.

tile.rawType: int, int, int, int, int, int, int : Index, X, Y, Width, Height, X offset, Y offset

primary_stat.rawType: predefined_string, predefined_string : Primary stat, Lesser primary stat
primary_stat.doc: Required primary stat(s). The lesser stat is optional.

auto_actionbar.doc: Flags items of this type to be automatically added to the actionbar (if the item has a power) when obtained. Defaults to false, except if the 'id' of this type is 'consumable'.

auto_pickup.doc: Allows items of this type to be picked up automatically.

id.doc: A power id from powers/powers.txt for this upgrade.

requires_level.doc: Upgrade requires at least this level for the hero.

requires_not_status.doc: Upgrade requires not having this campaign status.

requires_point.doc: Upgrade requires a power point to unlock.

requires_primary.rawType: predefined_string, int : Primary stat name, Required value
requires_primary.doc: Upgrade requires this primary stat to be at least the specificed value.

visible.doc: Controls whether or not a power is visible or hidden regardless of unlocked state. Defaults to true.

visible_check_locked.doc: When set to true, the power will be hidden if it is locked. Defaults to false.

visible_check_status.doc: When set to true, the power will be hidden if its status requirements are not met. Defaults to false.

visible_requires_not_status.doc: (Deprecated as of v1.11.75) Hide the upgrade if we have this campaign status.

visible_requires_status.doc: (Deprecated as of v1.11.75) Hide the upgrade if we don't have this campaign status.

animation.doc: The animation that will be played when this visual effect is triggered. Required.

automatic.doc: Determines if the visual effect will be applied automatically without having to be triggered from a dialog node. Defaults to false.

duration.doc: Sets how long the visual effect will last.

id.doc: An identifer for this visual effect. Required.

render_above.doc: Determines if the animation is rendered above or below the NPC. Defaults to true.

requires_not_status.doc: A list of campaign statuses that are required to be not set in order to trigger this visual effect.

requires_status.doc: A list of campaign statuses that are required to be set in order to trigger this visual effect.

image.doc: Filename of an image that will be shown.

separator.doc: Places an invisible gap of a specified height between elements.

text.doc: A single, non-wrapping line of text.
